profile_text.body:
Coursera is a public company, founded in 2012 and headquartered in Mountain View, California, that trades under the ticker COUR. Its own site describes an online learning platform offering courses, Professional Certificates, Specializations, and degrees, with content from organizations including Google, Meta, Anthropic, DeepLearning.AI, and Stanford. It also offers Coursera Plus, described as an annual subscription giving unlimited access to thousands of courses, Specializations, and Professional Certificates.

The site presents programs aimed at job-ready skills, naming the Google Project Management Professional Certificate, the Google UX Design Professional Certificate, the IBM Data Science Professional Certificate, the AI Essentials Specialization, the IBM Data Analyst Professional Certificate, the Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, the Machine Learning Specialization, the Deep Learning Specialization, the AI Engineer Professional Certificate, the Data Analysis with Python Specialization, and the UI/UX Design Specialization. It lists artificial intelligence, SQL, and web development among broad areas learners can browse, and mentions project management, UX design, data science, cybersecurity, data analytics, business, product management, and business analysis as fields its programs address.

The company's profile lists a CIK of 0001651562 and identifies it as a for-profit public company. No lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
